title: Official Cap
wikitext: {{Infobox mousehat |name = Official Cap |image = Official Cap.png |achievement = Ol' Mariner |ad = Catch 24 different [[fish]]. |price = {{Price|2000}} }} The '''Official Cap''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be purchased from the [[Abandoned House]] for {{Price|2000}} after earning the "Ol' Mariner" [[Achievements|Achievement]] (catch 24 different [[fish]]). It can also be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. There is a ≈2% chance to receive the gender-neutral outfit with the Official Cap. ==Notes== * The Official Cap outfit also includes the [[File:Shirt240.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Officer Uniform]] and [[File:Farmer Pants.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Farmer Pants]] (dyed RGB value 53,52,91). ==Trivia== * This hat may be a reference to the recurring character, Harris, from Harvest Moon. In ''[[wikipedia:Harvest Moon 64|Harvest Moon 64]]'', he was the town's mailman, and in ''[[wikipedia:Harvest Moon: Back to Nature|Harvest Moon: Back to Nature]]'' and ''[[wikipedia:Harvest Moon: Friends of Mineral Town|Friends of Mineral Town]]'', he is the town's policeman. ==References== Male players have 47 possible outfits (1/47 ≈ 2.13%), while female players have 48 possible ones (1/48 ≈ 2.08%). See Content\Data\MakeoverOutfits.xnb. [[wikipedia:RGB color model|RGB]] refers to "Red,Green,Blue". ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.6|Purchase price increased from {{Price|1000}} to {{Price|2000}}.
